composition.controls: one concordant-negative and one concordant-positive BDR control, both selected retrospectively (not pre-registered); not healthy/normal-lung-function controls
composition.design: purposively selected challenge set; not a representative sample

data_sources.survey: NHANES 2011-2012 (cycle G), CDC public-use files; unweighted

generation_commands: python3 src/build_items.py      # needs private benchmark/item_specs.yaml and grading_spec.yaml

gli_implementation.age: RIDAGEYR, whole years; rspiro looks up splines at floor(age*4)/4, exact for whole years; range 3-95
gli_implementation.height: BMXHT / 100 (m); BMIHT = 3 retained and flagged height_not_straight
gli_implementation.imputation: none; predictions NA when age, sex or height unavailable
gli_implementation.validation: Four reference cases (C1-C4) against the ERS GLI calculator (3 dp) and an independent Python implementation from the GLI lookup workbook; max |difference| 3e-14 over all participants with predictions (docs/methodology.md, Validation)

ers_ats_2022: Stanojevic S et al. ERS/ATS technical standard on interpretive strategies for routine lung function tests. Eur Respir J 2022;60:2101499. doi:10.1183/13993003.01499-2021. Change in FEV1 or FVC >10% of predicted.
gina_2026: GINA 2026 Summary Guide, Table 1, p.8: 'Adults: FEV1 or FVC increases by >=12% and by >=200 mL from the pre-bronchodilator value'. https://ginasthma.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/GINA-Summary-Guide-2026-WEB-WMS.pdf
GINA 2026 Strategy Report, Box 1-2, pp.28-29: 'Adults: increase from baseline in FEV1 or FVC of >=12% and >=200 mL'. https://ginasthma.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/GINA-2026-Strategy-Report-WMS.pdf
gli_global_2022: Bowerman C et al. A race-neutral approach to the interpretation of lung function measurements. Am J Respir Crit Care Med 2023;207:768-774 (GLI Global 2022).

guideline_thresholds.lln: GLI Global 2022 (Bowerman et al., AJRCCM 2023), 5th centile

rubric: 8 points per item (classification_and_calculation 4, scientific_explanation 3, limits_and_uncertainty 1); critical-error flags recorded independently
